commands.name: stringn
arguments: @HELP FINISH AND DEFEND THE PYRAMIDS OF GIZA!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Take 50 stones, 40 marble columns and 70 gold to the pyramids.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: If possible, build at least one warehouse near the Pyramids.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Supply the Egyptians with at least 25 soldiers.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Repel the attacks by the dark army.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Pay the merchants a tribute of 45 bowls of honey.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Pay the Byzantines the requested tribute for the mercenaries.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Hand the Bedouins weapons as a tribute, and they will go to war with you.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Take your heroes back to the Pyramids!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Pay Miguel the tribute if you need his help!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Look for the other Bedouin tribes if you want to help them!

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Pay the Egyptians the requested tribute for Pharaonic warriors.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: Hand the magicians 100 herbs for the magic protective wall.

commands.name: stringn
arguments: The outsides of the Pyramids of Giza were to be painted white and smoothed out to sparkle in the sun like giant crystals. In order to achieve this, we had to use the three months of the inundation. However, we were not safe from enemy attacks ...
